name: The Pacific Garbage Patch
author: ZhuAlexander07
description:
Thank you for trying out our game! We are hoping to create a video game that promotes water conservation and raises awareness about water-related issues around the world. Currently, some of the features are not completed, but the game is fully functional.

This game was created under the mentorship of the Xylem Inc. Ignite program. The project is co-led by Alexander Zhu and Emily Cohen, and contributed to by Samuel Kelson. 

If you see any bugs, please report them to alexanderzhu07@gmail.com!

(Game design/Programming by Alexander Zhu || All Art by Emily Cohen || Data Input Programming by Samuel Kelson)
